newsitem.title: UK: Ronson doubles estimated loss for 1996.
newsitem.headline: Ronson doubles estimated loss for 1996.

text.p: British consumer brands distributor Ronson Plc said on Monday it expected to report a loss of about 2.0 million stg for 1996, roughly double the figure it previously estimated.
Ronson attributed the revised estimate to additional bad debt provisions.
The company said it would report results this month.
Ronson said its chief executive, Howard Hodgson, had resigned with immediate effect and would be succeeded by Shaun Dowling.
Ronson's shares fell 2.5p to 14 by 1435 GMT.
